subject: Marketplace bundles & region priority — decision and owners
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace bundles & region priority — initial ask

Team,

Thanks for jumping on this. Per the CloudOne pilot (they want GA listing across AWS/Azure/GCP), we need to agree on:

- Which SKU bundles to list per cloud (minimal friction vs. packaging parity)
- Region coverage for GA (they care about US, EMEA later)
- Who owns co-sell onboarding per cloud (partner outreach + paperwork)

I've attached a working matrix (redwood_marketplace_bundle_matrix.xlsx) with initial proposals. High-level guidance I think makes sense:

- Single-entry SKU per cloud + 2 expand SKUs (dev / enterprise) to keep listings simple for buyers and operations.
- Prioritize US regions for GA (us-east for AWS/GCP, eastus for Azure).
- AWS will need us to satisfy their co-sell checklist (see aws_co-sell_requirements.pdf).

Please review the matrix and reply with your recommended deltas and who will own outreach to the marketplace PMs. I want to lock decisions by EOD Wednesday so we can start the listing submissions.

Thanks — Sergio

--
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Angela Wu <angela.wu@gcp.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace bundles & region priority — initial ask

Thanks Sergio — quick read and a few notes from marketplace constraints: 

1) Cloud-specific SKU guidance (hard constraints):
   - AWS: prefers a single canonical SKU per AMI/Container listing. Additional "tiers" should be separate listings. Co-sell requires an approved listing + partner auth.
   - Azure: supports plans within a single listing (so we can have dev/enterprise as plans). Good for simplifying buyer UX.
   - GCP: limited visibility for multi-plan; recommends separate SKUs for billing clarity.

2) Region availability:
   - For GA: US (primary) + Canada optional. EU needs legal review (data residency), push to follow-on phase.

3) Operational ask: Marketplace ops wants us to provide:
   - One canonical SKU per cloud for GA (makes approval cycles faster),
   - Pricing bands and per-hour/per-seat language, and
   - A short product listing copy + logo assets.

Action items I propose:
- Jonas: own technical listing assets (images, quickstart).
- Laura: own pricing tiers + sales collateral.
- Karthik: own partner-facing comms and co-sell enrollment for AWS.
- Sergio: approvals and drive deadlines.

Cc'ing Angela from GCP to confirm their preferred approach for plans vs. separate SKUs.

Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@cloudone.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace bundles & region priority — initial ask

Hi Sergio / Vanessa / Laura,

Appreciate the clear ask. A couple of preferences from CloudOne side as we scope pilot: 

- We prefer the single-canonical SKU approach on AWS and Azure (easier for procurement teams). For GCP, separate SKUs are fine as long as billing aligns.
- For GA we'd like US coverage only, but need availability in us-east and us-west for redundancy. EMEA later (Q3/Q4).
- Pricing: Can we include a 90-day pilot price (discounted hourly) for our initial customers? We'll provide a short procurement note if you can supply a pilot SOW template.

If you can share the draft listing copy and the pilot pricing matrix by Friday, procurement will fast-track approval.

Luca
Head of Platform Partnerships | CloudOne
luca.rossi@cloudone.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@cloudone.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace bundles & region priority — initial ask

Team — attached is a cleaned-up bundle/pricing proposal and the short product copy (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-marketplace-bundles). Highlights: 

- GA SKUs (canonical per cloud):
  * Entry (single SKU) — 1 vCPU-equivalent pricing, hourly metered; includes 2k tokens/day cap; $0.10/hr equivalent list price.
  * Growth / Pro (listed as plans where supported) — monthly commitment with higher throughput and enterprise support add-on.

- Cloud mapping:
  * AWS: Canonical listing + separate listings for Growth/Pro (to satisfy AWS billing + co-sell).
  * Azure: Single listing with plans (Entry / Pro) — fewer approvals required.
  * GCP: Separate SKUs per tier for billing transparency.

- Regions for GA: us-east-1 (primary) and us-west-2 (redundancy). We will flag EMEA as a future phase.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Jonas to finalize all technical assets by EOD Thursday.
2) Sergio to sign-off on final pricing and confirm we can offer a 90-day pilot discount.
3) Karthik to open co-sell enrollment for AWS and loop in partner SA.

Luca — this aligns with your ask; Laura will share the pilot SOW template in a follow-up if you confirm.

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@cloudone.com>, Angela Wu <angela.wu@gcp.com>, Sean Baker <sbaker@azuremarketplace.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace bundles & region priority — decision and owners

All — thanks for the alignment. Final decisions: 

- GA listing approach: canonical SKU per cloud (Entry) + Growth/Pro as separate listings on AWS/GCP, plans within Azure.
- Regions: us-east primary + us-west redundancy for GA. EMEA to be scoped for Q3.
- Pilot: 90-day discounted pilot price approved; Laura to publish SOW template and pilot pricing sheet to the Drive folder.
- Owners: Jonas (technical assets + listing upload), Laura (pricing + SOW), Karthik (co-sell enrollment + partner comms), Vanessa (marketplace approvals), Sergio (final sign-offs + timeline enforcement).

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Jonas: upload images, quickstart, and test AMI/container by EOD Friday — link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-marketplace-bundles
- Laura: publish pilot SOW + pricing by EOD Friday.
- Karthik: open AWS co-sell enrollment and confirm partner SA contact by Mon 8 Mar.
- Vanessa: confirm listing timelines with GCP/Azure PMs and share any additional verification requirements.

Luca / Angela / Sean — looping you for visibility. If CloudOne can confirm pilot customers this week we will prioritize approvals.

I'll send a short calendar invite for a checkpoint next Tuesday. Thanks everyone.

Sergio
